title: HELIX Bridge (Reverse): HELIX Enrollment → Banner SaaS (Ethos)
api_method: Banner Integration API (BIA) / Ethos business-process API
write_model: Registration is process-governed. Use the registration/section-registrations process which validates holds, prerequisites, capacity, and time tickets. Direct resource POST is often disabled; treat as process invocation with server-side validation.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map helix/enrollment-status to the registration status GUID (registered/dropped/withdrawn/waitlisted).

attribute_mappings.notes: FLAG: grading option field name varies by Ethos version.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Set by the registration business process, not directly writable in most tenants.

constraints: Registration is a BUSINESS PROCESS. Direct writes to section-registrations are gated; many tenants require the registration process API which enforces prerequisites, holds, capacity, and time-ticketing.
Registrant (student) and section GUIDs must pre-exist.
Holds, prerequisites, and capacity rules are enforced server-side and can reject the write — handle rejections, do not retry blindly.
